utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing something for the repair drive — do you know what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and we still need a few hands for setup and sorting donations. I can keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an ear out and can help with setup if you still need people on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve already been telling folks about the repair drive, and I can keep spreading the word today. If you’ve got any specifics, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — please keep spreading the word that we still need volunteers, tools, and items to fix. We’re aiming to get a good turnout by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word that we still need volunteers, tools, and items to fix, and I’ll push for a good turnout by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — thanks, Oren. I’ll bring the tools and point you to the fence panel and gate when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll pick a time around school pickup and let you know. Thanks for tracking supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s at the front porch this Saturday. I need a few helpers, and if you can, please keep track of any changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll keep track of any changes for the front porch drop-off this Saturday. If you want, I can also note who’s helping so it stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please note who’s helping, and let me know if anyone else volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the logistics—do we know what’s needed most for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got the spare screwdriver and blue tape ready, and I’ll swing by when I can. If I hear of any more names for the repair drive, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—I’m mostly trying to keep the Sunday drop-off at the community center organized. If you hear what still needs to be brought most, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what would you like me to bring or help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We could still use a few more volunteers and any small tools for the urgent fixes, like wrenches or screwdrivers. Thanks for asking!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help look for a few more volunteers, and I can bring a wrench or screwdriver too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’m free this afternoon, so I’ll meet you by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll see you by the garage this afternoon. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—see you this afternoon by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit out of the loop, honestly—if there’s any update on what the repair drive still needs, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still a little out of it, but I think they could use more volunteers and a few tools. I’ll mention it if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep an ear out too, and if I hear who’s needed I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — it’s still on, but it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep passing along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll send out the final details soon and let everyone know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know when those final details go out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping an eye on the supplies, and I’ll let you know if we start running low on anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep spreading the word and reminding folks about volunteers, tools, and items to fix. Hopefully we can get a strong turnout by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of what we’ve got and let you know if anything starts running low before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not caught up, I’m afraid—if you hear what they still need, let me know and I can try to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll pass along whatever I hear. Hopefully it’s just a few small things left.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out too, in case I catch any details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got the spare screwdriver and blue tape for the repair drive, and I’ll swing by when I can. If I notice any more names, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now — the screwdriver and tape should help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll bring the screwdriver and blue tape and swing by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. If you could help set up the front porch and keep an eye on incoming donations this Saturday, that would really help me keep the repair drive on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll set up the front porch and watch the donations this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear — I’ll keep mentioning the urgent fixes while I’m out. Just point me to anything that needs a quick push, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — the main thing left is getting a few more names for the repair drive. If you can keep mentioning that and the urgent fixes, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep telling folks we need a few more names and that the urgent fixes are the priority. I’m out running errands anyway, so I’ll spread the word as I go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina, I’m trying to work around the school schedule for the repair drive — what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I was thinking Saturday morning around 9 at the front porch — does that work for the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 should work for me — thanks for checking around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Dane — I’m tracking the drop-off spot and any changes, so if you can help keep an eye out for updates or bring supplies, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can keep an eye out for updates and bring supplies if needed. Just let me know what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my ladder, extension cords, and tarp set aside for the repair drive. Just let me know what else you still need, Kira.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, it’s still happening as far as I know—I'll let you know if I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already been telling folks, and I can keep spreading the word this afternoon. If you want, I’ll make sure a few more neighbors hear about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — just let folks know we could still use the most-needed items and any extra hands. I appreciate you helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll pass that along this afternoon and make sure folks know you still need the most-needed items and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Sunday now at the community center, and I’ll share the exact time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Sunday at the community center now—thanks for the update, Mara. Just send the exact time when you get it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll send the exact time as soon as I have it. Thanks for helping spread the word, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, I just need a quick reminder of what needs fixing again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — we’re still gathering the final list, but it’s mostly small household fixes like loose hinges, squeaky doors, and a few minor leaks. I’ll send the full details soon, and it’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rosa — send me the list when you have it and I’ll do what I can. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can still help with pickups if that’s useful. I’ll meet you by the garage this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Meeting by the garage this afternoon works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll see you there this afternoon.
